'''Shadow Twelve''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of [[Shadow Squadron (New Republic)|Shadow Squadron]]. The pilot was killed during the [[Battle of Selaggis]] when [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']] fired on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field the Republic forces were flying through.
